signal-blue.purpose: Primary actions, authorization links, focus rings. The only accent.

on-signal.purpose: Text and icons on Signal Blue fills.

cool-chassis.purpose: Page and popup background — the chassis every panel mounts on.

ink-readout.purpose: Primary text: headings, job titles, field values.

slate-mute.purpose: Secondary text: subtitles, metadata, field labels, footer versions.

panel-white.purpose: Card and settings-section surfaces on the chassis.

hairline.purpose: 1px structural borders on cards, fields, error lists.

chip-fill.purpose: Status pills, counts, term chips, inline code backgrounds.

quiet-fill.purpose: Secondary and icon button surfaces — available but not shouting.

quiet-ink.purpose: Text and icons on quiet fills.

inset-wash.purpose: Recessed readouts: job rows, form fields, code chips — one tonal step deeper than the card.

caution-amber.purpose: Attention notices: pending handoffs, expiring authorization, warnings.

verified-green.purpose: Success notices only — a durably accepted capture. Always weight 600.

redline-wash.purpose: Tinted error backgrounds: danger-button hover, error list. No ramp — a translucent wash.

headline.purpose: Popup page title (18px). Options page steps up to 22px for its single h1.

headline-page.purpose: Options-page h1 at 22px — the long-lived document title.

title.purpose: Section headings inside cards at 14px (15px on the options page).

body.purpose: Default 12px popup copy: notices, job rows, buttons, header summary.

body-lg.purpose: Options-page form copy and input values at 13px.

label.purpose: Pills and counts at 11px/600. Course legends sit one step up at 12px/600 in Slate Mute.

meta.purpose: Job metadata and footer versions at 11px/400 — the quietest legible tier.

code-display.purpose: Device-flow authorization codes in the popup at 16px/700 with 0.08em tracking.

code-inline.purpose: Inline code in options copy (YYYY-fall, 012) at 11px/400 on Chip Fill at 4px radius.

code-display-lg.purpose: Authorization-page code chip at 28px/700 with 0.16em tracking — bigger than any headline, because it must be transcribed by hand.

code-id.purpose: Extension ID chips at 11px/500 — Slate Mute on Inset Wash, truncated with ellipsis past 150px.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action accent: Connect GitHub, Save, authorizing links. 6px radius, 7px 10px padding, 12px system type. No hover change — states snap.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Available-but-not-primary actions: Refresh, Reset, Reload, Clear uploaded. Quiet fill on quiet ink. No hover change — states snap.

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive controls (Remove course, Discard). Transparent fill with a 1px Redline outline; hover tints Redline Wash; focus ring stays Signal Blue like every other control.

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: 28x28 utility control in the popup header (settings gear). Quiet fill; brightens on hover; 16px inline SVG icon.

components.name: Card
components.description: Section container on the chassis: 1px hairline border, 8px radius, 12px padding, flat.
components.html:
Upload queue

No uploads queued.

components.name: Job Row
components.description: The flight recorder's atom: one capture in the pipeline. Recessed inset row with title, metadata, and small nested actions.
components.html:
Lecture 12 — Transactions
EECS 484 · 2026-fall · queued

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Compact state readout in the header and section headings: counts, drain state. Fully rounded chip fill at 11px/600. Options-page term chips run 12px with a Redline-on-hover remove glyph.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-block; border-radius: 999px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; padding: 4px 8px; background: var(--pill-bg, #e6eaf0); color: var(--pill-fg, #4f5d72); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field with inset fill and hairline border; 13px values; error state driven by aria-invalid. Focus ring is Signal Blue at 1px offset (2px on the native toggles).

components.name: Code Display
components.description: Machine evidence in mono: device-flow codes at 16px/700 tracked 0.08em in the popup, escalating to 28px/700 tracked 0.16em full-width on the authorization page.
components.css:
.ds-code { display: inline-block; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--job-bg, #f7f9fc); color: var(--fg, #172033); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.ds-code-lg { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: center; font-size: 28px; letter-spacing: 0.16em; }

components.name: Status Notice
components.description: One-line outcome readout in aria-live regions. Resting tone is Slate Mute (the info level); variants: info (slate mute), warn (caution amber), success (verified green, 600), error (redline).

narrative.overview:
The extension chrome is the instrument panel of a capture pipeline that must never lose a recording. Every surface reports state the way a cockpit readout does: counts, connection status, queue depth, last outcome. Nothing on screen exists to please; everything exists to tell the operator what the pipeline has done and what it still owes. The result is utilitarian calm — dense, quiet, and impossible to misread in the two seconds a student spends checking whether the lecture actually uploaded.

This is a GitHub-adjacent operational aesthetic: system typography, hairline-bordered panels, one action blue, and status colors that mean exactly what they mean in a runbook. The popup is a fixed 390px canvas stacked with full-width sections; the options page widens to a calm 760px column without changing its vocabulary. Both ship as paired light/dark token sets so the panel reads correctly at 2am the night before an exam.
keyCharacteristics: Flat instrument panel: hairline borders and tonal steps only — never shadows
Dense system-typography scale (11–18px) tuned for a fixed 390px popup
One action accent (Signal Blue), reserved for primary actions, links, and focus rings
Status as color-coded readouts — amber, green, red — always paired with plain words
Every surface color ships as a light/dark pair selected by prefers-color-scheme

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue is reserved for primary actions, links, and focus rings. Its rarity is what makes the next action findable; it is never chrome, never decoration, never a status.

rules.name: The Scheme-Pair Rule
rules.body: Every surface color ships as a light/dark pair selected by prefers-color-scheme. Never build a screen from the light values alone — the 2am case is a first-class scene.

rules.name: The Words-First Rule
rules.body: Status colors only ever accompany plain words. Green means nothing without "uploaded"; red means nothing without the failure it reports.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Evidence Rule
rules.body: Monospace marks machine facts — authorization codes, IDs, raw labels. Prose is never mono, and mono is never used for emphasis.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Structure Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are separated by borders and tonal steps. No box-shadows, glows, gradients, or backdrop filters — a shadow in this system is a bug, not a style.

dos: Do separate surfaces with 1px Hairline borders and the Cool Chassis → Panel White → Inset Wash tonal ladder.
Do ship every color as a light/dark pair and let `prefers-color-scheme` pick; test both schemes.
Do reserve Signal Blue for primary actions, links, and focus rings — and give every interactive control that 2px focus outline (1px offset; 2px on the settings toggles).
Do use Verified Green, Caution Amber, and Redline only to report outcome state, always next to plain words.

Do hold the type scale: 11px labels/meta, 12px popup body, 13px options form copy, 14px (15px options) section titles, 18px (22px options) page titles — and let only the mono code readouts break it (16px popup, 28px authorization page).
Do render machine facts — codes, IDs, raw labels — in the mono stack.
donts: Don't introduce box-shadows, glows, gradients, or backdrop filters; depth is borders and tonal steps only.
Don't use monospace for prose, or Signal Blue as decorative chrome.
Don't add webfonts or decorative type; the system stack is the identity.
Don't add motion for its own sake — state changes are instant today; introduce transitions only with a stated reason.
Don't override native form affordances beyond accent-color and focus outlines.
Don't let status colors appear without the words they color.
